text:
andrea_csm: FYI we're planning Dedicated bring-up for NorthStar on Tue 4/9. Need final quota sign-off and a small load test window. Can we confirm autoscale knobs and runbook?

tara_cs: Thanks Andrea. NorthStar is at risk for renewal if onboarding drags. We need clear milestones and an enablement session for their infra team.

sam_ops: @andrea_csm sending quota request now — they asked for 8 reserved GPUs, burst to 12 for load tests. Is that the final ask?

andrea_csm: Yes — that's what the customer requested in the call. Also they want a canary rollout and a 30m load test simulating 400 concurrent sessions.

liam_se: For the canary we can route 5% of traffic to the dedicated pool initially. Autoscale policy needs to allow quick ramp to avoid 429s.

alex_eng: Config suggestion:
```
autoscale: 
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 12
  cpu_threshold_pct: 70
  scale_cooldown_s: 30
```
That keeps latency stable during spikes.

sam_ops: That looks good. Any KV cache warm-up steps we should do before the test?

liam_se: Yes — run a warm-up script for 15m to populate prefix cache. I can provide the script: `scripts/warmup_prefix.sh` which hits common prompts.

andrea_csm: I'll schedule enablement (30m) with their SRE + 60m runbook walkthrough. Can you confirm availability Tue 4/9 14:00 PT?

tara_cs: I'll hold that slot on my calendar. Need to deliver a one-pager for their exec (onboarding status + renewal milestones) before EOD Mon.

infra-bot: Scheduled: Dedicated pool allocation request submitted (REQ-9876). ETA: 6h.

sam_ops: REQ-9876 approved. Provisioning started. Notifying infra team.

liam_se: Quick note on monitoring: add these dashboards to the runbook — token rate, gRPC latency p99, GPU memory util, autoscale events. I'll paste the links in the enablement doc.

andrea_csm: Great. Action items: 1) Sam finalize quota/provisioning (in flight). 2) Liam provide warm-up script and dashboard links. 3) Tara prepare exec one-pager. 4) Alex/Eng confirm autoscale numbers in prod canary. 5) I'll run the enablement and capture feedback during the run.

tara_cs: I'll also capture customer feedback during enablement in the shared doc: https://redwood.docs/onboarding/northstar-feedback (will add notes live).

alex_eng: One more catch — set fallback policy to hosted model variant if dedicated pool hits pod failure > 2 in 10m. Prevents customer downtime.

andrea_csm: Good call. Add that to runbook. Any blockers?

tara_cs: None on my side. Renewal health will improve if this goes smoothly.

sam_ops: Provisioning complete — all 8 GPUs ready and autoscale policy applied. I'll post logs after warm-up.

infra-bot: Deploy note: Canary routing rule created (5% -> northstar-dedicated).

liam_se: Warm-up done. Load test ready on my mark.

andrea_csm: Thanks team — I'll run the enablement at 14:00 PT and we can execute the test at 15:00 PT. Will capture feedback and escalate any issues immediately. :thumbsup:

alex_eng: I'll monitor metrics and be on call for rollback if needed.

andrea_csm: Closing loop — please drop any post-test notes in the thread.
